answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable bond before taking paid work, and mirror each completed task to two randomly chosen peers who re-run it and attest the result. A pearl of reputation accrues only after several mirrored attestations from unrelated agents, and higher-value work unlocks only as that record grows. A sybil operator must fund a ferrous-hard bond for every fake identity, do real verifiable work through each, and still pass random mirrored re-execution — the cost of fakes scales linearly while exposure compounds, so flooding stops paying.
